$comment: FULLY SYNTHETIC target-trial specification. No real patient data. Two-arm design modelled on a generic advanced-NSCLC EGFR-TKI comparison. Used to show how an emulation is specified before any estimate is computed.
title: Synthetic target trial: third-generation vs first-generation EGFR-TKI in EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC
thesis_note: Decision support only. An emulation from synthetic data does not replace a randomised trial.

estimand.population: Adults with stage IV EGFR-mutant (exon 19 deletion or L858R) non-small-cell lung adenocarcinoma, treatment-naive, ECOG 0-1.
estimand.intervention: Third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor, first line.
estimand.comparator: First-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor, first line.
estimand.outcome: Progression-free survival (time to progression or death).

published_reference.source: Synthetic stand-in. Not a citation to a real trial.
